name: whiteboard-animation
description: The Whiteboard Animation MCP server and a skill that turns pictures into hand-drawn whiteboard animation videos.

interface.shortDescription: Turn pictures into hand-drawn whiteboard animation videos
interface.longDescription: Give Codex a picture, or a whole folder of them, and Whiteboard Animation draws each one stroke by stroke as a hand-drawn whiteboard video: sketch first, then colour, with or without a hand. Codex can quote the cost, start the drawings, follow them to completion and render them as MP4, transparent WebM or PNG. Sign in once with your WhiteboardAnimation.ai account; new accounts get free credits.
defaultPrompt: Draw every picture in ./scenes as a whiteboard animation and save the MP4s to ./clips.
Turn this diagram into a whiteboard animation for a lesson, drawn with a right hand.
How many Whiteboard Animation credits do I have left?
